versions.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Stability Framework (ASF):

- Provides a unified framework to prevent agent drift, catch faults, and ensure soul alignment.
- Includes comprehensive documentation, file templates, and ready-to-use system prompt additions.
- Features detection checklists, scoring system, and daily self-audit tools.
- Compatible with all major LLMs and agent use cases.
- Designed for quick setup and minimal maintenance.
